Layout and full contents of the reverse mapping table and the host capability masks are not shown.
Behavior of the vendor specific after set hook, memory management hook, performance counter refresh and interception recalculation is not shown.

findings.text: Extended state size descriptor holds three unsigned 32 bit values capturing size, placement and attribute outputs for one subleaf of the extended state enumeration. A file private table holds one descriptor per possible extended feature, initialized once at boot and thereafter treated as read only.

Boot time initializer populates the extended state size table from hardware for every subleaf at or above the vector extension start, querying the processor directly and storing the three outputs per entry. It runs once before any size computation and has no inputs or outputs beyond filling the table.

Size helper derives the minimum save area length for a requested feature bitmap under either standard or compacted layout. It starts from a fixed header contribution, restricts the bitmap to recognized extension bits, then extends the span by each requested component using stored size and placement, applying stricter alignment for flagged components in compacted mode.

CPUID table lookup asserts that interrupts remain enabled on entry as a performance guard, since the table can be large and the call path is expected to avoid hot paths with interrupts disabled. The check is diagnostic and does not alter lookup results.

Lookup scans the supplied table in order and requires equality of the function identifier. When the stored entry marks its index as significant, the supplied index must also match, otherwise the first function match wins and callers must avoid ambiguous duplicates. Direct internal queries may use a sentinel index meaning not significant, in which case the first function match wins but an architecturally indexed function triggers a one time warning. A miss yields absence.

Two small vCPU helpers provide the standard lookup surface, one accepting an explicit index and one implicitly requesting the not significant sentinel, both delegating to the generic table scan over the cached entries and count.

Post set validation enforces that the virtual address width exposed in the extended address leaf, when present, belongs to a small allowed set including zero for unspecified, otherwise the update is rejected. It then inspects the primary extended state leaf for user dynamic bits and, when any are present, delegates to the floating point subsystem to enable corresponding guest extended control features.

Equality verification first refreshes runtime owned bits and applies the paravirtual quirk to the current view, then requires identical entry count and identical function, index, flags and all four register values for every position, rejecting on any difference.

Hypervisor discovery iterates over candidate base leaves, reads the leaf entry when present, reassembles a three word signature from its secondary registers and compares against the requested signature. On match it records the base and the advertised limit, otherwise it reports no hypervisor.

Paravirtual features quirk resolves the hypervisor base via signature matching, locates the features leaf derived from that base, and when HLT exits are disabled for the VM it clears the unhalt capability from that leaf. It returns the resulting features word or zero when the hypervisor or leaf is absent.
HLT handling predicate reports guest execution when the per VM disabled exits control includes the HLT bit.

Runtime refresh clears the dynamic bits dirty marker and reconciles selected leaves with live state. It synchronizes three capabilities in the basic feature leaf with control register, APIC enable and miscellaneous enable state, honoring a quirk that suppresses the wait capability, synchronizes one protection key capability in the structured leaf, and recomputes save area lengths for the extended state leaves using current control masks, with compacted sizing only when either save variant is advertised.
Single feature runtime update keeps the visible entry and the cached guest capability consistent by setting or clearing the same translated bit in both locations according to the supplied boolean.

Guest capability cache is organized as one word per translated leaf. Setting adds the translated bit, clearing removes it, and changing selects between those actions based on a boolean, with leaf and bit derived through translation helpers.

Feature numbering passes through a translation that remaps a bounded list of kernel internal features to virtualization specific numbers and leaves all others unchanged. Leaf derivation divides the translated number into words and bit derivation selects the low five bits, with compile time checks enforcing word count equality, exclusion of host only words, bounds against the reverse table, and non empty mapping for every usable leaf.

Mapping from abstract feature to visible register proceeds by translating the feature, looking up a descriptor holding function, index and destination register, then addressing one of four output words in the entry. A single bit constructor derives the mask for a named capability from its translated position. Predicates test presence by masking with the translated bit, and mutation sets or clears that bit without affecting neighboring bits.

Control register bit test restricts the mask to guest possible bits, refreshes the cached register from hardware when owned bits intersect the request and the cached value is not yet available, then reports whether any requested bit is set. The single bit wrapper additionally requires its argument to be a power of two at build time.
Quirk presence is determined by a single atomic read of the per VM disabled quirks mask, reporting present when the queried bit is not disabled.

Supported extended control masks are derived by combining two halves from the relevant extended state subleaf and intersecting with the host supported mask for that class, yielding zero when the subleaf is absent from the guest view.

Hyper-V enablement is false unless the corresponding build option is present and the interface leaf exists with the expected identification value. Vendor compatibility for AMD family is decided solely from the three signature words of the basic vendor leaf, accepting either of two AMD encodings or the Hygon encoding.
Direct register fetch by selector returns the corresponding output word of the entry and, for an unrecognized selector, emits a one time warning and returns zero.

After setting guest CPUID the vCPU reconstructs derived state in a fixed order. It clears cached capabilities and rebuilds them by intersecting host capabilities plus emulated bits with the guest entries, refreshes runtime bits, adjusts the large page capability according to paging mode and hardware or guest support, updates timer mode and version when the local APIC exists, caches supported extended control masks and paravirtual features, records vendor compatibility and address limits and reserved address bits, refreshes performance counters, combines host and guest reserved control bits using a temporary alias for the host query, updates Hyper-V state, invokes the vendor hook, updates memory management state, and finally requests recalculation of interceptions.

Public CPUID maintenance surface includes the after set hook that rebuilds all derived vCPU state from the newly installed entries, the query that reports the guest physical address width with fallback when extended leaves are missing, the helper that reports reserved address bits from that width, and the Hyper-V cache synchronizer that mirrors selected enlightenment leaves.

Enumeration uses leaf 0 for vendor, leaf 1 for basic features, leaf 7 for structured features, leaf 0xD for extended state, and leaves 0x80000000 and 0x80000008 for address width discovery. Absent address data yields 36 bits, while virtual width validation accepts 48 and 57 besides 0 for unspecified.

Reserved guest physical address bits are those at and above the cached maximum width up to the top of the 64 bit range, computed by a helper that builds a contiguous mask between bounds. The width accessor simply returns the per vCPU cached maximum.

Mask helper produces ones over an inclusive interval within a 64 bit word, normalizing a variable upper bound into range, returning zero for an empty interval, and enforcing at build time that a constant upper bound stays within range and that constant bounds are ordered.

Software emulated table covers only the zero index of indexed functions and reports unsupported otherwise. It advertises a fixed maximum for the basic leaf, always advertises one string operation and conditionally advertises the wait operation when partial emulation is requested, and for the structured leaf marks the index significant while conditionally advertising an identifier capability only when the host reports its prerequisite.

Host capability store is a global array with one word per translated leaf, marked for frequent reading, plus a boolean configuring marker with the same locality. Queries test the translated bit within the corresponding word.

Generic guest capability queries must not be used for certain dynamic capabilities whose values are refreshed lazily at emulation time, with build time rejection for three named controls, while the wait control remains explicitly permitted for direct query.

With translation caching active the guest large page capability follows hardware support regardless of guest enumeration to avoid inconsistent faults, otherwise it follows guest enumeration alone. Separately, table lookup is linear and potentially large, so performing it with interrupts disabled signals a performance risk even though results stay correct.

Hyper-V synchronizer records the enablement flag, warns when enablement is requested without an allocated per vCPU structure, clears the cached enlightenment state, exits early when disabled, and otherwise copies selected feature, enlightenment, debug and nested leaves into dedicated cache fields when those leaves exist.

Extended state sizing starts from a fixed header length plus offset, iterates only over extension components at or above the vector start, and aligns flagged components to a 64 byte boundary when computing compacted size.

Boot initialization of extended state sizes and the after set hook form the lifecycle boundaries for CPUID derived state, the former preparing global size data before any vCPU exists and the latter rebuilding all per vCPU derived state after userspace installs a new table.

Generic table search is available to other compilation units, accepting a caller supplied entry array with count plus function and index to locate, and reporting the first qualifying entry or absence according to significance rules.
Local APIC timer mode uses shift 17 with one or two bits set depending on deadline timer presence, with version refresh performed alongside when the APIC exists.
Diagnostic formatting prefixes every message from this compilation unit with the module name.
